_comment: category + noiseEffective + suppress drive the Exposure Dashboard verdict and the content-script stand-down. noiseEffective:false means the tracker filters synthetic events (isTrusted:false), so Phantom's noise does not reach it. suppress:true means Phantom disables behavioral injection on pages running it, because the noise is both filtered AND can feed a bot/fraud score (pure downside). Captcha widgets are noiseEffective:false but suppress:false (too common to disable everywhere; they still filter our noise).
